Today's selection covers 91 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 63 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: GhostAction Hacking Wave Fizzles, But Attackers Lurk on in GitHub

• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 53 articles published in the last 24 hours
